cohort: The study cohort initially included 134 women with type 1 diabetes (T1D) treated with insulin pumps, later matched to 42 CGM users and 42 SMBG users, to assess the risk of LGA.
finding: Mothers of LGA infants, despite reaching target HbA1c, had higher first-trimester HbA1c, higher time above target, higher mean glucose concentrations in each trimester, and more glycemic fluctuations.
